args.command: echo '=== WIFI PROFILE ORDER ==='; for c in zen-home-wifi zen-home-2f zen-iphone-hotspot; do;   echo PROFILE=$c;   nmcli -g connection.autoconnect,connection.autoconnect-priority,802-11-wireless.ssid connection show "$c" 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,3p' || true; done

meta.summary: Read-only inspect Wi-Fi autoconnect priorities for home and iPhone hotspot profiles
